policy.distinction: class=unreachable/status=SUCCESS is a successful stock MIR-Unreachable guard assertion and is not status=UNREACHABLE; coordinates alone do not resolve post/frame/relation obligation roles, covers, wrappers, oracle, or binary-after gates.

limits: All classification consumes compact structured JSON members only; stdout/stderr previews and raw logs were not inspected.
The four complete groups and ten failed/incomplete groups are distinguished. Per-row missing-site count is separate from group-level completeness; all rows in failed groups remain UNKNOWN.

Exact located records support source/property observations even in incomplete rows; qualification of every row in a failed group remains UNKNOWN. No missing location is inferred from identifier, count, group order, or function name.
A same-run source verdict or exact negative oracle is a structured observation, not independent proof credit.
The full qualified target/contract-wrapper binding and post/frame/relation role analysis remain pending as applicable. Proof credit B1/B2 remains NONE; it is reported separately from qualification.
No counterfactual relaxation of the exact coordinate policy was applied; no historical receipts or ledgers changed.
